title: Create a pod
instructions: In namespace `exam-workloads`, create a pod named `web` using image `nginx:1.27`.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get pod web -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].image}')" = nginx:1.27

title: Create a deployment
instructions: In namespace `exam-workloads`, create a deployment named `api` using image `nginx:1.27` with 2 replicas.

checks.command: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get deployment api -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}')" = nginx:1.27
test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get deployment api -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')" = 2

title: Expose a deployment
instructions: Expose the existing deployment `service-target` in namespace `exam-workloads` as a ClusterIP service named `api` on port 80 targeting port 80.
check: kubectl -n exam-workloads get service api -o json | jq -e '.spec.type == "ClusterIP" and .spec.selector.app == "service-target" and any(.spec.ports[]; .port == 80 and .targetPort == 80)' >/dev/null

title: Create a ConfigMap
instructions: In namespace `exam-workloads`, create a ConfigMap named `settings` with key `mode` set to `production`.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get configmap settings -o jsonpath='{.data.mode}')" = production

title: Create a Secret
instructions: In namespace `exam-workloads`, create a generic Secret named `credentials` with key `username` set to `operator`.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get secret credentials -o jsonpath='{.data.username}' | base64 -d)" = operator
solution: kubectl -n exam-workloads create secret generic credentials --from-literal=username=operator

title: Create a ServiceAccount
instructions: Create a ServiceAccount named `observer` in namespace `exam-workloads`.
check: kubectl -n exam-workloads get serviceaccount observer -o name

title: Set a resource quota
instructions: Create a ResourceQuota named `limit-pods` in namespace `exam-workloads` limiting the number of pods to 10.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get resourcequota limit-pods -o jsonpath='{.spec.hard.pods}')" = 10

title: Create a Job
instructions: Create a Job named `hello` in namespace `exam-workloads` using image `busybox:1.36` which runs `echo hello`.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get job hello -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image} {.spec.template.spec.containers[0].command[0]} {.spec.template.spec.containers[0].command[1]}')" = 'busybox:1.36 echo hello'
solution: kubectl -n exam-workloads create job hello --image=busybox:1.36 -- echo hello

title: Label a node
instructions: Add the label `exam=ready` to any node.

title: Create a persistent volume
instructions: Create a PersistentVolume named `exam-pv` with capacity 1Gi, access mode ReadWriteOnce, storage class `exam-local`, and hostPath `/tmp/exam-data`.
check: test "$(kubectl get pv exam-pv -o jsonpath='{.spec.capacity.storage} {.spec.accessModes[0]} {.spec.storageClassName} {.spec.hostPath.path}')" = "1Gi ReadWriteOnce exam-local /tmp/exam-data"
solution: Create a PersistentVolume manifest with capacity.storage: 1Gi, accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce], storageClassName: exam-local, and hostPath.path: /tmp/exam-data; apply it with kubectl.

title: Claim persistent storage
instructions: Create a PersistentVolumeClaim named `exam-claim` in `exam-workloads`, requesting 1Gi with ReadWriteOnce and storage class `exam-local`.
check: test "$(kubectl -n exam-workloads get pvc exam-claim -o jsonpath='{.spec.resources.requests.storage} {.spec.accessModes[0]} {.spec.storageClassName}')" = "1Gi ReadWriteOnce exam-local"
solution: Create a PersistentVolumeClaim manifest requesting 1Gi with accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce] and storageClassName: exam-local, then apply it in exam-workloads.

title: Default deny ingress
instructions: Create a NetworkPolicy named `deny-ingress` in `exam-workloads` selecting all pods and denying all ingress traffic.
check: kubectl -n exam-workloads get networkpolicy deny-ingress -o json | jq -e '.spec.podSelector == {} and (.spec.policyTypes | index("Ingress")) and ((.spec.ingress // []) | length == 0)' >/dev/null
solution: Apply a NetworkPolicy with podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Ingress], and no ingress rules in exam-workloads.

title: Create a Role
instructions: Create a Role named `pod-reader` in `exam-workloads` allowing get, list, and watch on pods.
check: kubectl -n exam-workloads get role pod-reader -o json | jq -e '.rules | any((.apiGroups | index("")) and (.resources | index("pods")) and (.verbs | index("get")) and (.verbs | index("list")) and (.verbs | index("watch")))' >/dev/null

title: Bind a Role
instructions: Bind the existing Role `binding-reader` to ServiceAccount `binding-observer` in namespace `exam-workloads` using a RoleBinding named `read-pods`.
check: kubectl -n exam-workloads get rolebinding read-pods -o json | jq -e '.roleRef.kind == "Role" and .roleRef.name == "binding-reader" and any(.subjects[]; .kind == "ServiceAccount" and .name == "binding-observer" and .namespace == "exam-workloads")' >/dev/null

title: Troubleshoot a deployment
instructions: The `broken-web` deployment in namespace `exam-repair` cannot start. Fix its image to `nginx:1.27` and ensure it has one available replica.
solution:
kubectl -n exam-repair set image deployment/broken-web web=nginx:1.27
kubectl -n exam-repair rollout status deployment/broken-web

checks.command: test "$(kubectl -n exam-repair get deployment broken-web -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}')" = nginx:1.27
test "$(kubectl -n exam-repair get deployment broken-web -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')" = 1

title: Schedule a Job
instructions: Create a CronJob named `periodic` in `exam-workloads` using `busybox:1.36`, scheduled every five minutes, running `echo hello`.
solution: kubectl -n exam-workloads create cronjob periodic --image=busybox:1.36 --schedule="*/5 * * * *" -- echo hello
